marketing_wrapper: Moderate. A dark slate-blue gradient backdrop with a white two-line caption and a black phone silhouette. 02-06 show the top ~75% of a screen at near full width (real UI ~70% of the image). 01 overlaps the phone with two 3D band renders that hide the tab bar and part of the home feed.

typography.display: unsure: score numerals in a DIN-like straight-sided bold sans (75%, 85%, 14.2, 29.9); the WHOOP wordmark sits above each score in a thin wide logotype
typography.body: unsure: a geometric-humanist sans resembling Proxima Nova for insight copy and captions; not SF
typography.numerals: DIN-style bold numerals, large in gauges, right-aligned in metric rows (124, 49, 14.5, 1:05, 12,459); percent sign smaller
typography.weights: Bold numerals; Semibold all-caps labels; Regular body
typography.case_and_tracking: All-caps with wide letterspacing for metric labels, screen titles and links ('HEART RATE VARIABILITY', 'TODAY', 'DIVE INTO MY SLEEP'); sentence case for coaching copy

palette.accent_strategy: Per-metric fixed colours: Sleep is slate blue, Strain is blue, Recovery takes the banded traffic-light colour (green at 85%). Small semantic triangles mark trend vs the prior 30 days (teal up, amber down, grey flat). Insight cards use a purple-to-teal gradient outline and periwinkle caps links. Base is a cool navy-slate, not black.
palette.source: palette.json 02-04 (#12171a, #191f24, #21292e, #243039 cover ~80% and are shared by UI and backdrop), 03 (#486f58 green ring tint), 05 (#3d6b62 particle orb) + visual match

shape.radius_language: small-to-medium ~12pt cards; pill/capsule tab bar and date switcher; circular gauges
shape.borders_shadows: Thin hairline dividers between metric rows; gradient 1pt outline on the coach insight card; subtle top-highlight gradient on cards; a caret notch joins the gauge to the metric card
shape.materials: Dark gradient surfaces; translucent floating capsule tab bar; a particle-glow orb on Healthspan

liquid_glass_visible: yes: floating capsule tab bar ('Community', 'More') with a separate circular WHOOP coach button at its right (01), matching the iOS 26 bar-plus-accessory layout
density: medium-high: home stacks three gauges, an insight card, two monitor tiles and the My Day list; detail screens use 4-row metric tables; 12-16pt rhythm
layout: Home: avatar + flame streak count, a TODAY date switcher, battery chip; WHOOP wordmark; a row of three equal ring gauges (Sleep %, Recovery %, Strain 0-21); a coach insight card; Health Monitor and Stress Monitor tiles; 'My Day' with Daily Outlook and activities. Each score drills into a screen with one big ring gauge, a 4-row contributor table and a coach card.
navigation: Floating glass tab bar (items partly hidden; 'Community' and 'More' visible) plus a separate round coach button; detail screens have a back chevron, centred caps title and an info button
imagery_and_icons: Thin outline custom metric icons (lungs, heart, dumbbell, shoe); generative particle orb for Healthspan; abstract fluid-art thumbnails for lab panels; no photography in-app
signature_visual_move: Each score is a thick single ring on navy-slate with a huge DIN numeral inside and the WHOOP wordmark above it, notched into a caps-labelled contributor table.

direction_fit.why: Readiness Dashboard (now a Glance Board variant) is confirmed: a score triad of rings, Recovery banded green, Strain on 0-21 (14.2), dense scroll home and a coach button. The tinted navy-slate base with white numerals and per-metric colour also matches Cinematic Dark Data's dark-data look.

notes: Daily score: three equal-size ring gauges (Sleep 80% slate-blue, Recovery 85% green, Strain 14.2 blue); only Recovery uses the traffic-light band, so the triad is equal-weight but not all traffic-light. Strain's ring shows a white target tick, so the Recovery-derived Strain target is drawn on the ring. Sleep contributors use three-segment bars coloured Poor amber / Sufficient grey / Optimal teal. Streak: a flame glyph with '355' next to the avatar (top-left of Home); no calendar shown. Charts: segmented mini-bars and a 'Pace of Aging' tick-strip scale (-1.0x to 3.0x) with a pointer; no line charts visible. Numerals: DIN-like bold, right-aligned in rows, with trend triangles. The equal-weight triad is exactly the fitness-module anti-pattern 'equal-weight score triads', which suggests the module rule critiques the category leader itself.
